outline.item: Break a deepfake, catch a hallucination, and turn the check into something you'll still do next month.

faq.q: Do I need any background in tech?
faq.a: None. If you can use a phone and a browser, you can do this. We start from what these tools are and build up from there.

faq.q: I already use ChatGPT every day. Is this too basic for me?
faq.a: Probably not. Most daily users were never shown the media-literacy half — spotting a deepfake or a fabricated citation — or how to get consistent results instead of lucky ones. We work on your real tasks, so it meets you where you are.

faq.q: What do I need to bring?
faq.a: One real task from your week — a document, an email thread, a decision you're chewing on — and whatever AI tool you already have. That's it.
